title: Taklow Kernewek ('Cornish Things') — Cornish language text resources
notes: Taklow Kernewek's Neocities site hosts digitized Middle/Late Cornish texts including 'Gwreans an Bys' (The Creation of the World, Cornish ordinance/cycle play, MS 1611) in plain text, as confirmed by the live files https://taklowkernewek.neocities.org/GwreansAnBys_segmented.txt and .../kernewekFSS/GwreansAnBysConvertedSWF.txt (after the transcriptions by W. Stokes and N. Jordan). Origin verbatim: 'Gwreans an Bys (Cornish, MS 1611)'. Licence not stated on site. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Taklow Kernewek (Tony Hakoyama), Neocities personal project; text after Stokes 1861 / Jordan
